sources.description: T-Motor's datasheet table for MN7005 KV230 with the P24*7.2" CF propeller at 24 V, as an image posted in post 17 of ArduPilot forum topic 144558 (data/flight-logs/inventory.json, bench table tmotor-datasheet-mn7005-kv230-p24x72).

T-Motor's product page for the MN7005 Antigravity KV230 (store.tmotor.com/product/mn7005-kv230-motor-antigravity-type.html), read on 2026-11-07: internal resistance 71 mOhm and weight 188 g, both including the cable; idle current 0.9 A at 22 V; peak current 28 A and maximum power 700 W over 180 s.

applicability: KV from the datasheet table's heading; the other values from T-Motor's product page (resistance and mass include the cable).
